title: SMOK Solus 2 Replacement Pod 0.9ohm 3 Pack
description: These replacement Solus 2 pods feature a built-in 0.9ohm mesh coil that provides a discreet yet satisfying MTL sensation. The coil’s mesh build helps the E-Liquid heat quicker, producing even richer flavour. When your coil begins to lose flavour, simply swap it out for a new one. The pods attach securely to the device with strong magnets, and depending on which way you insert the pod, you can also adjust the airflow for a tighter MTL draw, or a looser RDL (restricted direct-lung) sensation. The Smok Solus 2 2ml pods feature a slim, comfortable mouthpiece and are refillable via a silicone-stoppered seal on the pod’s side. This means you can always carry your favourite flavour E-Liquid with you or swap out flavours to experiment. We recommend High-PG, 50/50 and Nic Salt E-Liquids for use with the Solus 2 pods. Slim, light and incredibly simple to use, the Smok Solus 2 refillable pod kit is an ideal kit for newer vapers or those seeking a convenient back-up device.
